line_endings: LF. Hashes are computed on the working-tree bytes with `.gitattributes` set to `* text=auto eol=lf`, so a CRLF checkout on Windows would NOT reproduce them. Verify with `sha256sum` under Git Bash, not PowerShell against a CRLF working copy.
invalidation_rule: If any hash below changes, every artifact derived from that source is INVALID and must be re-derived, never silently reused.

SRC-001_requirements_2026-08-14.md.what: The client's product requirement brief. Original file CLIENT_ASK.md, clause-numbered, no wording changed.

SRC-002_build_mandate_2026-08-14.md.what: The client's build mandate: stack, AWS free-tier constraints, work zones, build order. Original file CLAUDE_CODE_BRIEF.md, clause-numbered, no wording changed.

SRC-003_client_rulings.md.what: The client's answers to SRC-001 §10 (30 questions). Until this exists, all 30 are OPEN rows in CONSTITUTION.md Article X and may not be guessed at.

notes: A hash comparison is the weaker guarantee: it proves a file was not edited, it cannot see a requirement the file never contained. Where a document is GENERATED, the stronger check regenerates and compares content.
The originals CLIENT_ASK.md and CLAUDE_CODE_BRIEF.md remain in the repository root as the client handed them over. They are not cited by anything. All citations point at the SRC files.
